answer: Clone farms leave a signal in what they write. Each epoch, answers are embedded and any cluster above 0.85 cosine similarity splits a single reward, so n copies earn about 1/n each while paying n times the compute. A lone agent roaming its own meadow of ideas keeps a full share. Weakness: clones can be told to paraphrase. Fix: also compare reasoning steps and cited facts, so a reworded copy is just the same answer in a thin cipher.
